tools.name: quote_trip
tools.description: Price a trip without booking it: the driver payout (given, or our local rate), the platform fee, the total the dispatcher pays (tax included) and, when addresses and time are given, the client price a passenger would pay. Nothing is saved.

tools.name: book_trip
tools.description: Book a prepaid job for verified chauffeurs. Within the agent key's limits and with a saved card it is paid and published at once; otherwise it waits for the account holder (waiting_for says why, pay_url is their link). Always confirm the trip details and the total with the user before calling. order

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: One job with its status, driver, vehicle, plate and timeline once accepted.

tools.name: list_bookings
tools.description: The account's jobs, newest first. Optional status filter, e.g. OPEN, ACCEPTED, COMPLETED, CANCELLED.

tools.name: cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel a job. The website's cancellation terms apply: once a job is published the platform fee is kept. Confirm with the user before calling.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "book_trip" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "book_trip" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
